purpose: Teach: ドナー/太陽系/火薬/油田

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、臓器ドナーの倫理研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered the ethics research on organ donors in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Calm unhurried teacher's opening, clear articulation, gentle confirming rise on the tag ending.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、太陽系外惑星の天文学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — and I covered astronomy research on planets beyond the solar system in my paper.
lines.style: Quick earnest yes, then pace lifts with genuine enthusiasm for the subject.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、古代の火薬製造の歴史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered historical research on ancient gunpowder manufacture in your paper too, didn't you.
lines.style: Reflective and slightly slower, as if reviewing his file, thoughtful emphasis on the topic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、中東の油田開発の経済史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered economic-history research on Middle Eastern oil field development in my paper.
lines.style: Steady eager reply, careful precision on each term, a small proud lift at the close.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ドナー登録制度の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you also covered sociological research on the donor registration system, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm measured recap tone, gentle downward cadence, quietly impressed beneath the composure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、太陽系の起源説の物理学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered physics research on theories of the solar system's origin in my paper.
lines.style: Bright final answer, faintly breathless enthusiasm, settling into a satisfied, rounded close.
